facts.fact: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare) gives Rs 6,000 a year per family in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000
facts.quote: Financial benefit of Rs. 6000 per annum per family payable in three equal installments of Rs 2000 each, every four months.

facts.fact: PM-KISAN eligibility: all landholding farmers' families with cultivable land in their names (the criteria set no age limit)
facts.quote: All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in their names are eligible to get benefit under the scheme.
facts.note: 'No age limit' is read from the published eligibility and exclusion criteria, which mention no age (derived).

behaviour: Replies in Hindi. Lists Central schemes from myScheme that match only the stated facts (farmer, age 62; Uttar Pradesh only as residence), with each scheme's published criteria cited (e.g. the myScheme PM-KISAN record); uses the templated eligibility wording (the Department determines eligibility) and gives the myScheme eligibility link; no eligibility verdict; does not assume landholding size, income, caste or BPL status.
fail_if: It gives a yes/no eligibility verdict; lists PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana as open to him (entry age 18-40 only); lists UP State schemes as Central; assumes unstated facts (income, caste, BPL card).
summary: Added PM-KISAN benefit and eligibility (myScheme record) as an example scheme; PM-KMY (entry age 18-40, pmkmy.gov.in) kept only in fail_if.
